finish_summary: 1) Cart.remove_item: After removing all units, the item remains with quantity 0 instead of being removed entirely (spec says remove entry). 2) Cart.total calculation is incorrect for member shipping and coupon scenarios – the implementation does not apply shipping on discounted subtotal or miscomputes discount. 3) Cart.total does not raise ValueError for an invalid coupon code as specified; it returns a value instead. 4) The test incorrectly referred to cart.subtotal() as module attribute – no mismatch with spec, just test error.
